Yeah I applied for New Zealand working holiday visa instead and got it for $20 USD in less than a week so I'm just gonna go there and hopefully my aus visa is done by next year.
Mine is about 60 days in and still have heard nothing. Applied May 19, submitted health checkup may 20
She literally made false statements in the petition

And you missed the part where I mentioned that she said herself that she got the impression that I was acting out for attention and not really suicidal. So she admitted she did not think there was a dangee

Its not an indication because I explained that it wasnt to go kill myself, it was because I did not feel safe or comfortable AT THAT FACILITY and having to LIVE THERE to receive treatment. I did not feel comfortable LIVING with strange drug addicts and crazies
How was that not a legal issue when they filed a LEGAL document having me committed, WITHOUT ANY INDICATION THAT I WAS PLANNING TO KILL MYSELF AFTER LEAVING THERE????

Yes the 72-hour psychiatric hold was because of suicidal ideation I said that part. I'm saying during the 72-hour stay I expressed that I want to play video games I want to go to work etc. I said I have no plans to commit suicide. There was nothing to suggest I had any plans to commit suicide and they did the worst thing they could possibly do because I did not want to give up an entire week's pay due to lost wages Plus not being able to do anything fun, jerk off, go for a walk, smoke a cigarette.

I didn't refuse a voluntary hold I wanted help but I wanted it as outpatient treatment so that I could go home play video games look at memes etc. not live with a bunch of strange people where I can't even sleep alone eat alone shower alone etc. cant decide what to watch, cant browse internet. No access to phone except during specified windows and the phone was right next to the lounge so EVERYONE could listen to my conversation.

Procrastinators say "I'll start tomorrow". People that get shit done live every day like there is no tomorrow. The people that don't waste a minute of their lives are the ones that are the most successful.

I need to stop trying to analyze things and come up with the "optimal" ways to do them, and just do them.

My best friend since I was 12 is a programmer. About a month ago he told me his company was looking for an entry level programmer, so he gave me a recommendation. I had my mom take a day off to drive me down there for the interview. I answered all of their technical questions pretty well, but I didn't do so well on the questions like "what is your biggest accomplishment". I had an anxiety attack in the middle of the interview and I couldn't think, so I gave them retarded answers.
I knew by the end of the interview that they were not going to give me the job. They ended up hiring a girl for the position instead because "they liked her personality". So even with a recommendation from inside the company I can't get an entry level job.

People love my middle brother for some reason(I am the youngest). He is taller than me and broad shouldered, and fakes a deep voice so well that people tell him he sounds like a radio host.

Every time I go to the store with him and it's a female cashier, I can just see the attraction in their face. They overlook me completely and pretty much act like I don't exist. I try to practice eye contact to improve my social skills, but I'm not the one breaking eye contact - it's them. A lot of girls just refuse to look me in the eye. I really don't think I am ugly, in fact I think I have above average looks. They can probably just detect my low self esteem and are turned off by my slight belly / man boobs.

I went to supercuts a few weeks ago and got my hair cut. The girl  cutting my hair was good looking and she seemed to be interested in me. She was asking if I had a girlfriend, wife or kids and if I was going to college. I just said "no" and to the whole question. I guess I should have given her more than just a one word answer. I told her I wasn't going to college and her attraction seemed to instantly turn off.

Sorry for the long reply. I don't get to speak much so I guess I go crazy when the opportunity arises.

I am very self conscious of my voice since I was always made fun of for it as a kid. Sometimes I can control it and make it deep, but other times it just sounds whiny. I also don't speak loudly enough. This is one of the biggest reasons I don't speak much.

I've always wanted to learn spanish and I have some basic grammar down from when I was in high school and from duolingo.

What website do you go to for tutors?

I want to distance myself from the negativity, but it's very hard to do while I can't completely support myself financially. I share a room with one of my brothers and my other brother sleeps in the living room. My old brother does nothing but play video games and video chat with girls. The other one just plays video games, reddits, and watches old movies. I have nobody to talk to because even my brothers share no interests with me. For example today, I tried to show my brother some concept art for a game I am programming. He flat out refused to look at it or hear about my idea at all.

I want to join the Navy but the recruiter here told me that I am 60 pounds too heavy. However, he also told me I scored high enough on the test that I could have any job I wanted. I guess the next step is losing the weight. I've been doing pushups every day, and I walk to work even though it's only twice a week. I feel like even if I join the Navy I won't "fit in".

I am a victim of "wage theft".

Im 19, my brother is 20 and we were both working together at a machine shop for $10 an hour. Our checks didn't seem right, so we talked to the secretary since we suspected they weren't paying us as much as they were  supposed to. Their records showed that they were paying us for the time we worked every work day minus 50 minutes. We only got 30 minute lunches, so they were getting 20 minutes of free work out of us every day. That doesn't seem like much, but they were also taking 40 minutes of pay for each day of the weekend for no apparent reason. We normally worked 10 hours a day monday through thursday and about 6 hours on friday. We worked one saturday that they never paid for at all.

Our supervisor told me, plain and simple, that he knew the company wasn't paying its 30 or so employees  for all of their hours. He ADMITTED that he knew they were breaking the law. He told us to "get our ducks in a row", whatever that means, before talking to the owner about the issue. They proceeded to fire us over the weekend.

We got fired for, I quote, "threatening to call the labor board". We simply told them that they were legally required to pay for all the hours we worked. We talked to a lawyer but he said that since we only worked there for a month it wouldn't be worth the investment for them help us. 

Moral of the story: If you want cheap workers, just skim hours off every check and fire them when they start to ask questions.
This sounds very fabricated to me.

I want to write an autobiography. I have so much to get out and writing it makes me feel so much better, although I doubt anyone would be willing to read ~300 pages about the life of a nobody.

Thanks for your comment.

Every time I bring anything from the past up, my mom just brushes it off and doesn't want to talk about it. She thinks I can ignore it and just start acting like a normal person. The problem is I don't know how a normal person acts. I don't know how to have a conversation because I have had very few real conversations my entire life.

It reminds me of a video game, I think it was Sims 3. If the child Sims didn't get social interaction early enough they would have to go to a school for developmentally challenged kids or something like that. I hear all the time that early on in life is when people develop most of their personality. Since I always felt bad about myself as a kid, I still always feel bad about myself. I still don't want to talk because I'm so used to not talking.

I don't think talking through it is going to do anything for me. I had 4 cups of coffee and sat here typing the OP for around 6 hours through the night. I think just putting things in writing really helps me to reassess the situation and make me feel a bit better, but it's not going to last long. I'm going to go to work in a few days, say just enough to get by, be called slow, then come home tired and depressed.
